ev.q: Overall, 71.5% of index transgender women were interviewed for partner services
Fewer than half (46.5%) of notified transgender women partners were tested for HIV
approximately one in five (18.6%) of those who were tested received a new diagnosis of HIV infection
Overall, 71.5% of index transgender women were interviewed for partner services
which was lower than that for all index persons combined (81.1%)
adjusted prevalence ratio [aPR] for persons aged 35–44 years = 0.86
CDC analyzed HIV partner services data submitted by 61 health departments

methods_quotes.q: Multivariate binomial regression was used to assess the association between index person or partner characteristics and partner services outcomes.
associations between partner characteristics and diagnosis of infection with HIV were not analyzed
Data were stratified by age group, race/ethnicity, and U.S. Census region
